sections.heading: Refunds
sections.text: Prepaid treatment plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original card within five business days.

sections.heading: Cancellation fee
sections.text: Appointments cancelled with less than 24 hours notice carry a 40 dollar cancellation fee. The fee is waived for medical emergencies.

sections.heading: Opening hours
sections.text: The clinic opens at 8 in the morning and closes at 6 in the evening, Monday to Friday. Saturday hours are 9 to 1.

sections.heading: Parking
sections.text: Free parking is available behind the building on Maple Street. The garage entrance is on Elm Lane and closes at 7 pm.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.text: We accept Delta Dental, Cigna and Aetna insurance plans. Bring your insurance card to every visit so we can bill your plan directly.

sections.heading: Teeth whitening
sections.text: Professional teeth whitening costs 250 dollars per session. Results last about a year with good home care.

sections.heading: Cleaning
sections.text: A routine cleaning costs 90 dollars and takes about 45 minutes. We recommend a cleaning every six months.

sections.heading: Emergency care
sections.text: For dental emergencies after hours, call the on-call dentist line at 555 0199. Severe swelling or bleeding should go to the hospital emergency room.

sections.heading: Children
sections.text: Children are seen from age two. A parent or guardian must stay with patients under sixteen during the visit.

sections.heading: Payment methods
sections.text: We accept cash, debit cards, Visa and Mastercard. American Express is not accepted.

sections.heading: Payment plans
sections.text: Treatments above 1000 dollars can be split into a 12 month payment plan with no interest.

sections.heading: New patients
sections.text: New patients should arrive 15 minutes early to fill in the medical history form. Bring a photo ID.

sections.heading: X-rays
sections.text: Digital x-rays are taken once a year. Pregnant patients should tell the hygienist before any x-ray.

sections.heading: Braces
sections.text: Metal braces start at 4500 dollars. Clear aligners start at 5200 dollars and need a consultation first.

sections.heading: Implants
sections.text: A single dental implant costs 3800 dollars including the crown. Healing takes three to six months.

sections.heading: Root canal
sections.text: Root canal treatment costs 1100 dollars for a front tooth and 1400 dollars for a molar.

sections.heading: Sedation
sections.text: Nitrous oxide sedation is available for anxious patients for 75 dollars. You can drive home after nitrous oxide.

sections.heading: Wheelchair access
sections.text: The clinic is wheelchair accessible with a ramp at the front door and an elevator to the second floor.

sections.heading: Languages
sections.text: Our staff speak English, Spanish and Mandarin. Interpreters for other languages can be booked in advance.

sections.heading: Late arrival
sections.text: Patients more than 15 minutes late may need to reschedule. We will try to fit you in if the dentist is free.

sections.heading: Records
sections.text: Copies of dental records are sent within 10 business days of a signed request. Records transfer is free.

sections.heading: Night guards
sections.text: Custom night guards for teeth grinding cost 400 dollars and take two weeks to make.

sections.heading: Fillings
sections.text: Tooth coloured fillings cost between 150 and 250 dollars depending on size.

sections.heading: Covid precautions
sections.text: Masks are optional in the waiting room. Please reschedule if you have a fever or cough.

sections.heading: Gift cards
sections.text: Gift cards are sold at reception in amounts from 25 to 500 dollars and never expire.
